visible_sequence.observation: The ui4 harmless request is composed in Normal mode; the ui3 denied turn above it is history.
The new ui4 turn displays Tool call blocked and the assistant begins reporting the governance denial. No Allow once dialog appears.

A transient native streaming STEERING marker appears below the denial, reporting that the alternative-route suggestion was not applied. It is retained in the continuous footage and disappears in the finalized response.
The expanded Kiro Crew host notice identifies Blocked by governance policy and the exact @aws-enforcement/crew_denied deny pattern.

quality_limit: The original dark UI uses dim text in the host notice. Export retains it unchanged; the cue text and separately reviewed receipt make the exact rule readable without altering the captured UI.

evidence_boundary.service_arrival_claim: Supported separately by the completed ui4 service interval and stable service identity; not inferred from the video.
